text:
clare (BillingOps): Noticing ~30 Stripe invoice webhooks missing in NetSuite since 02:45 UTC. They appear in our event log but no NS invoice created.
gordon (Eng): Checking delivery status — our webhook queue shows 502 spikes around that time and a replay succeeded for some.
deploy-bot: [DEPLOY] webhook-processor v1.8.0 -> prod at 2025-01-11T02:40Z.
clare (BillingOps): timestamps line up with that deploy, could be a transient routing error.
frank (Finance): If invoices are missing, AR will be understated. Need quick scope and a plan to reconcile.
gordon (Eng): I found a race: the new processor adds idempotency keys but we changed key format; earlier events had old keys so dedupe check misfired and some retries 502ed then were dropped by the worker.
clare (BillingOps): can we safely replay the missed events? Any risk of duplicate payments?
gordon (Eng): Replay safe if we use external_id upsert and mark `source=webhook-replay`. I'll run a dry replay for 5 ids first: `./tools/replay --ids /tmp/missed_ids.txt --dry-run`.
clare (BillingOps): please post a sample payload so finance can validate amounts/AR buckets.
gordon (Eng): sample dry-run payload:
```
{"external_id":"stripe_inv_9Zx","customer_external_id":"cus_2Fp","amount":9800,"currency":"USD","metadata":{"source":"stripe"}}
```
frank (Finance): sample looks good. Proceed with full replay once you confirm dedupe logic corrected.
gordon (Eng): pushed patch to normalise idempotency key formats and added alert if worker drops event. Deploying now.
deploy-bot: [DEPLOY] webhook-processor v1.8.1 -> prod by gordon at 2025-01-11T03:10Z.
gordon (Eng): Running full replay now. Will monitor for duplicates and post results.
clare (BillingOps): holding manual reconciliations until we confirm all missing invoices are accounted for.
frank (Finance): thanks — after replay we'll run AR vs Stripe ledger diff and flag any discrepancies.
clare (BillingOps): closing loop once AR matches.
